## Index inspected; transcript not yet read
The 2000 Hansard subject index was read. Page 16168 of the debates was not opened. This is a finding aid, not a verified quotation of what was said.
:::

## Annotation

By 2000 the Legislative Assembly’s indexer used the program name (with “Choices,” plural). Mike Farnworth and Colin Hansen are the names attached to page 16168. Without the transcript, this archive cannot say what change was discussed or what founding year, if any, speakers used.

URL patterns tried for the 12 July 2000 afternoon Hansard file returned 404. A follow-up should use the Assembly’s current debate-transcript search for volume/page 16168.

## Open questions

- Exact date, volume, and wording of the page 16168 exchange.
- Whether earlier Hansard indexes (1993–99) use the CSIL name.
